summary.quick_take: Shopify and Payhip both sit in the broader e-commerce landscape, but they appeal to slightly different buying motions. Shopify leans into one-time payouts, while Payhip leans into recurring lifetime payouts. The better fit depends on whether you want the cleaner affiliate story, the broader positioning angle, or both.
